text:
Score: 5/10. The core code is organized and the unit-test intent is good, but I would not approve this as-is because a fresh checkout cannot run the documented demo or story generation path, and there are several runtime compatibility and artifact-staleness risks.

I estimate about 350 lines need rewrite or significant change: mainly data/bootstrap flow, model loading/token handling, artifact validation, integration-test gating, dependency pinning, and robustness checks.

I attempted `python -m pytest -q`, but this environment is missing project dependencies (`numpy`, `PyYAML`, `transformers`), so tests failed during collection rather than exercising the code.

issues.description: Default paths expect data/stories, but the repo's story dataset is empty so documented runs fail from a fresh checkout.
generate-stories reads an existing story manifest before generation, making regeneration impossible when the repo has no manifest.
Model loading passes dtype= instead of torch_dtype=, which is incompatible with the declared Transformers minimum version.
Integration test loads a gated external model and missing local data without preflight skips, making test-all unreliable in CI or fresh environments.
Dependencies are broad lower bounds only, leaving the project exposed to upstream API drift and non-reproducible runs.
Preference scoring assumes standalone A/B token IDs match continuation-token IDs in context, but this is not verified per tokenizer.
load_vectors accepts stale or incompatible vector artifacts without checking model, layer count, d_model, or configured emotions.
Validation trusts artifact shape and manifest compatibility, so mismatched model/config outputs can crash or silently score the wrong vectors.
Story-generation HTTP call has no timeout, retry, or response-status handling, so it can hang indefinitely or fail opaquely.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token or empty encoded texts after truncation.
pca_components divides by total variance without handling zero-variance inputs, producing NaNs.
emotion_vectors does not validate that every emotion label is present, so missing classes become NaN vectors.
Importing the package mutates global USER, LOGNAME, and TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR environment variables.
Generated packaging metadata is checked into the repository, increasing stale-build risk.
